description:
QUINTA DA RIA – “Beautiful views overlooking the Atlantic Ocean”

Designed by the architect Rocky Roquemore, Quinta da Ria has already been described by experienced golfers as the most breathtaking golf course in the region. The pleasant see views and sandy beach islands, combined with the mountain landscape of the opposite site undoubtedly make Quinta da Ria a golf paradise.

resourceTypes.description:
QUINTA DE CIMA “the Championship Course”

Designed by the architect Rocky Roquemore, Quinta de Cima offers different and very unique characteristics: wide fairways, well based bunkers and several lake and streams which calls for a good deal of precision playing. The water hazards of the course and the long fairways emphasize the need for a good club selection, challenging even the most experienced players.
